native_v6_scope: Original uncaught karto::Exception / exit -6 after controlled SIGINT is genuine. No native stack trace identified the throwing SDK instruction; this review does not attribute that exact abort conclusively.
confirmed_source_defect: SlamToolbox owns LaserAssistant, MapSaver, LoopClosureAssistant and CeresSolver, each of which previously retained the same node in a shared_ptr. These strong ownership cycles prevented node destruction, background thread joins, Dataset destruction and SensorManager unregister before main returned.
fix: Helpers and solver borrow the owning node with Node*. SlamToolbox joins threads before destroying helpers, mapper, Dataset and solver; active multirobot main resets the node after rclcpp::shutdown and before static teardown. Derived destructors first stop TF listener/filter callbacks while virtual callback state remains alive. Synchronous SLAM also joins its derived scan worker before its queue/mutex members are freed. Base teardown repeats both hooks harmlessly.
lifetime_review: Repository constructors are called by SlamToolbox::configure; the sole additional MapSaver constructor is in its derived MapAndLocalizationSlamToolbox and remains owned in the same base member. Mapper holds a non-owning ScanSolver pointer; no external shared solver/helper owner was found. rclcpp node base outlives these members.
ppo_scope: The update gate remains all required native closures before optimization. A failed collection saves only returned DecisionTransition tensors and receipts to failed_collection_*.npz/json, marked training_eligible=false, without GAE/returns, artificial truncation, synthesized terminal row or failed-native sample recovery. Other close calls are resolved and their errors retained before the first error propagates.
